purpose: Executable acceptance matrix for phpIPAM to NetBox laboratory validation.

scenarios.assertion: Zero-length records are preserved with an explicit warning; supported canonical prefixes and addresses are created in NetBox.
The real dump and API contain lower-case compressed canonical IPv6 values, including a /126 seeded with host bits, and NetBox receives those supported values.
Distinct VRFs permit duplicate prefixes; duplicate natural identities are conflicts; empty and duplicate RD behavior is explicit.
VID 1 and 4094 migrate; 0, 4095 and non-numeric IDs are preserved before any destination request; duplicate VID is safe across groups.
Parent/child, pools, status, tags and utilized state migrate; phpIPAM folders are preserved.

Gateway, a valid DNS name, valid MAC/interface assignment and an unambiguous primary IP migrate; an invalid DNS name is preserved without blocking its IP, and a portless device IP is warned and remains unassigned.
Unicode, emoji, CRLF/LF, HTML and Markdown pass unchanged at the schema limit; over-limit and control characters block planning.
Text, integer, boolean, date, selection, URL and JSON require compatible approved definitions; invalid/missing values block or preserve explicitly.
Customers migrate as tenants; contacts/roles require explicit approval; invalid contact data remains traceable.
Locations, racks, devices and interfaces require approved site, role, manufacturer, type and interface type; duplicate interfaces/MACs are conflicts.
Provider/type/circuit and safe A/Z terminations require approvals; incomplete, duplicate or ambiguous circuits do not partially migrate.
Only an explicitly confirmed static 1:1 pair migrates; PAT, incomplete, many-to-many and cross-VRF cases remain preserved.
Reuse, opt-in PATCH, ETag drift, lost responses, checkpoint resume and repeated apply are safe and idempotent.
SNMP secrets, API credentials, vaults, users, permissions and sessions never reach snapshots, plans, logs, reports or bundles.
